output.expected_benefit: Automated drafting of recommended sanctions based on disciplinary files, reducing manual workload and improving consistency in HR decision-making.
requirements: Access to restricted disciplinary files for analysis
Ability to generate draft recommended sanctions based on file content
Integration with HR systems to retrieve and update disciplinary records
Compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, internal policies)
Approval workflow for managers to review and finalize sanctions
Logging and audit trail for all generated drafts and actions
Minimal manual intervention for routine cases to improve efficiency
Scalability to handle 40+ monthly requests without performance degradation
